evidence.summary: CASI describes the Space Engineering University in Huairou, Beijing, as the PLA’s university for its space forces: founded in 1978 as a cadre school of the National Defence Science and Technology Commission and later the General Armament Department’s Equipment College, it became the Strategic Support Force Space Engineering University in 2017. It runs a space simulation training centre, a space test and training centre and a space monitoring and control station, and its specialties include space mission planning, early warning detection, weapon launch engineering, space target surveillance and space information security.

CASI places the university under the Strategic Support Force’s Space Systems Department; after that force was dissolved in April 2024, the PLA’s 2024 recruitment plan assigned it to the new Aerospace Force without changing its name.
